status_detail: Idaho Commerce announced Meta's over 960,000 sq ft Kuna data center, with groundbreaking planned for September 2022 and construction anticipated through 2025; later local coverage says the project is one of two large data centers approved in southern Ada County.
notes: Official state and Meta materials verify the project. Search results also identify the site near Cole Road and Kuna Mora Road and tracker pages list separate 99 MW buildings, but MW was not confirmed from official accessible sources in this pass.

status_detail: Diode describes Gemstone Technology Park as a 620-acre proposed data center site outside Boise in early development. BoiseDev reported Kuna City Council greenlit the 620-acre rezone in April 2025, and later reported the proposal was on hold because of an ongoing lawsuit. CoStar reported the campus was built to handle up to 800 MW.
notes: Capacity is from news coverage, not Diode's public project page. Local coverage says the project has approval but is delayed/on hold by litigation, so status is planned rather than construction.

project_name: Lex Developments Pocatello AI Data Center
aliases: Former Hoku plant AI data center
status_detail: Pocatello's May 14, 2026 Hearing Examiner agenda/staff report listed CUP26-003 for a potential data center at 1800 River Park Way on the former Hoku site. LocalNews8 reported on May 18, 2026 that the Hearing Examiner denied the conditional use permit; later coverage says the City Council upheld the denial. Bannock County separately adopted a 180-day moratorium on accepting or processing data center permit applications outside city jurisdiction.
notes: Official agenda identifies the CUP and location; developer name and appeal/denial status are from local/news coverage. Included despite city jurisdiction because Pocatello is in Bannock County and the county moratorium confirms local data center permitting activity.
